words.engDef: no later than that time

words.engDef: during the same period as something else

words.engDef: at this stage of a process

words.engDef: official permission to do something

words.engDef: knowledge that a situation or fact exists

words.engDef: in the most important respects; put simply

words.engDef: to not be present at a place or event

words.engDef: to know that something exists or is happening

words.engDef: to use something as the foundation for something else

words.engDef: to have firmly decided to do something

words.chinese: 充滿；充斥著（某事物），通常指數量或程度非常多。

words.chinese: 有能力、有機會做某事；處於能夠做某事的狀況

words.example: The company is owned by a private equity firm.
words.chinese: 屬於；被...擁有

words.engDef: to be connected with something
words.example: This project is related to the company's long-term strategic goals.
words.chinese: 與…相關；與…有關

words.engDef: to be unwilling to do something
words.example: The marketing team is reluctant to invest in a new advertising campaign due to budget constraints.
words.chinese: 不願意做某事；猶豫於做某事

words.engDef: to be pleased with what you have received
words.example: The project manager was satisfied with the team's progress and decided to move forward.
words.chinese: 對...感到滿意，接受...

words.engDef: to be planned to happen at a stated time
words.example: The meeting with the potential investor is scheduled for next Tuesday.
words.chinese: 被安排進行（某事）；預定進行（某事）

words.engDef: to be almost the same as something else
words.example: The new software's interface is very similar to the previous version.
words.chinese: 與...相似，與...雷同

words.engDef: to cover a wide area rather than one place
words.example: The company decided to spread out its marketing budget across multiple platforms to reach a wider audience.
words.chinese: 分散開來；攤開；擴散開來（通常指資訊、資源或人員）

words.engDef: to be expected or required to do something
words.example: You are supposed to submit your expense report by the end of the week.
words.chinese: 應該做、預期要做（表示義務、責任或計畫）

words.engDef: to have had enough of something and want it to stop
words.example: I'm tired of working overtime every weekend.
words.chinese: 厭倦；對...感到疲憊或不耐煩（通常指某事物或情況）

words.engDef: to not want to do something
words.example: The marketing team is unwilling to allocate more budget for the campaign.
words.chinese: 不願意做某事；缺乏意願

words.engDef: to stay awake until late at night
words.example: I had to be up late last night finishing the quarterly report.
words.chinese: 熬夜，晚睡，長時間工作或活動到深夜

words.engDef: to be familiar with doing something because it is usual
words.example: Our team is used to working long hours during peak season to meet customer demand.
words.chinese: 習慣於（做某事）；經常用於（做某事）

words.engDef: changed into or started to be something
words.example: The company became a leader in the renewable energy sector after years of research and development.
words.chinese: 成為，變成

words.engDef: started
words.example: The project began on schedule, despite initial setbacks.
words.chinese: 開始；起始

words.engDef: started, and now under way
words.example: The project has begun, and we need to allocate resources accordingly.
words.chinese: 開始；起始 (指某事已經開始進行)

words.engDef: the way a person or thing acts
words.example: The manager addressed the employee's inappropriate behavior during the meeting.
words.chinese: 行為；舉止；表現

words.engDef: later than the planned time
words.example: We are currently behind schedule due to unforeseen technical issues.
words.chinese: 比原定計畫落後；延遲

words.engDef: later than it should have been done
words.example: The report was submitted belatedly due to unforeseen technical issues.
words.chinese: 姍姍來遲地；晚了才...

words.engDef: to be the property of, or be a member of
words.example: This document belongs to the Marketing Department and should not be shared with others.
words.chinese: 屬於；歸屬於

words.engDef: to lean forward and down from the waist
words.example: Please bend over and pick up the dropped documents.
words.chinese: 彎腰；俯身

words.engDef: it is a wiser choice to do something
words.example: It would be better to schedule a meeting next week to discuss the budget.
words.chinese: 建議採取某種做法，通常表示比其他做法更有效或合適。

words.engDef: happening once every two years
words.example: The company holds a biannual sales conference to review performance and set goals.
words.chinese: 每兩年一次的；雙年制的

words.engDef: able to speak two languages well
words.example: Our company seeks bilingual employees to handle international clients.
words.chinese: 雙語的；能夠使用兩種語言流暢溝通的

words.engDef: happening once every two weeks
words.example: The newsletter is distributed biweekly to keep employees updated on company news.
words.chinese: 每兩週一次（發生的頻率）

words.engDef: a small mark or fault that spoils the surface of something
words.example: The quality control team found a small blemish on the product's surface.
words.chinese: 瑕疵；污點（指表面上的小缺陷，例如產品上的劃痕或文件上的錯誤）
words.rootPrefix: blesmir (to make pale, to wound, Old French)

words.engDef: a room where a company's directors hold meetings
words.example: The presentation will be held in the boardroom at 2:00 PM.
words.chinese: 董事會室；公司決策會議室

words.engDef: a shelf on which books are kept
words.example: The office manager asked the IT department to install additional bookshelves to accommodate the growing collection of training manuals.
words.chinese: 書架；書櫃

words.engDef: a local office of a larger company
words.example: Our company has several branch offices throughout Asia to better serve our clients.
words.chinese: 分支機構；分公司（通常指公司在其他地點設立的辦公室，以擴展業務或提供本地化服務）

words.engDef: to introduce something new or invite someone to take part
words.example: Please bring in the latest sales report for our review.
words.chinese: 引入、帶來（通常指帶入某物或某人），或將某事物引入到某個地方。

words.engDef: to cause something, usually unpleasant, to happen
words.example: The excessive workload is bringing on stress and burnout among the team members.
words.chinese: 引發；造成；促成（某種情況或問題）

words.engDef: quick and full of energy
words.example: The manager requested a brisk walk to clear his head before the important meeting.
words.chinese: 快速且有活力的；（步調）輕快、節奏明快

words.engDef: carried or took something to a place or person
words.example: The manager brought several important documents to the meeting.
words.chinese: 帶來；攜帶；引入

words.engDef: a board on a wall where notices are put up
words.example: The HR department posted the new company policy on the bulletin board.
words.chinese: 公告欄；佈告欄，通常用於張貼公司內部通知、海報或重要資訊。

words.engDef: causing a lot of difficulty or extra work
words.example: The new regulations are quite burdensome for small businesses.
words.chinese: 繁重的；負擔的；令人費時的

words.engDef: the formal clothes worn in a professional workplace
words.example: The company dress code requires all employees to wear business attire for client meetings.
words.chinese: 商務服裝；正式工作服裝，通常指在職場上穿著的專業服飾。

words.engDef: a small card printed with your name and work contact details
words.example: Please exchange business cards after the meeting to facilitate future communication.
words.chinese: 名片；用以交換聯絡資訊的卡片

words.engDef: people you know through work who may be useful
words.example: The sales team is actively expanding their business contacts to increase market share.
words.chinese: 商業聯絡人；業務關係人，指在商業領域中建立和維護的個人或組織。

words.engDef: a normal working day, not a weekend or public holiday
words.example: Please allow 3-5 business days for processing your order.
words.chinese: 工作天，不包含週末和法定假日。通常指星期一至星期五。

words.engDef: the times of day when a company is open
words.example: Please note that our business hours are Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM.
words.chinese: 營業時間，公司或商店的開放時間

words.engDef: a discussion about work matters
words.example: Let's schedule a business talk to discuss the new marketing strategy.
words.chinese: 商務談話；關於業務的討論

words.engDef: people who work in commerce or run companies
words.example: The conference attracted a large number of businesspeople from around the globe.
words.chinese: 商務人士；從事商業活動的人

words.engDef: to fasten the buttons on a shirt or jacket
words.example: He quickly buttoned up his shirt before the important meeting.
words.chinese: 整理儀容，穿好襯衫或西裝的鈕扣，使儀容整潔。

words.engDef: when compared with something that is very different
words.example: While the initial investment was substantial, the long-term returns have been even greater.
words.chinese: 相反地；與之相反；相比之下

words.engDef: done by a person rather than by a machine
words.example: Due to the high volume of orders, some items are still assembled by hand.
words.chinese: 手工地；以人工方式

words.engDef: accidentally, without meaning to
words.example: I accidentally sent the report to the wrong department; I did it by mistake.
words.chinese: 不小心地；錯誤地（指因疏忽或意外），通常指非故意的錯誤。

words.engDef: alone and without help
words.example: The employee completed the project by oneself, demonstrating excellent initiative.
words.chinese: 獨自地；靠自己的

words.english: by the end of the year
words.engDef: before the year finishes
words.example: The project is expected to be completed by the end of the year.
words.chinese: 在年底前；截至今年底

words.engDef: when a particular moment or event arrives
words.example: By the time the report is finalized, all data should be verified.
words.chinese: 在...之前；到...時（表示某件事情在另一件事情發生之前完成或發生）

words.engDef: by the moment being talked about
words.example: By this time next year, we expect to have completed the project.
words.chinese: 到目前為止；截至目前

words.engDef: to phone work to say you are too ill to come
words.example: I'm feeling unwell today, so I'm going to call in sick.
words.chinese: 因病缺勤；請病假

words.engDef: to cancel something that was planned
words.example: Due to the severe weather conditions, the company has decided to call off the outdoor training session.
words.chinese: 取消（計畫、活動等），通常是因為不可抗力或特殊情況。

words.engDef: is not able or not allowed to do something
words.example: I cannot approve this expense report without proper documentation.
words.chinese: 無法；不能（表示某事物不具備能力或許可進行某動作）

words.engDef: writing a letter as a capital, or a company's total share value
words.example: Please ensure correct capitalization of all proper nouns in the document.
words.chinese: 名詞，表示「大寫，資本化，股本總額」。在寫作中指將單字的首字母大寫的規則或行為；在金融領域則指公司發行股票的總市值或將成本轉化為資產的過程。

words.engDef: with close attention, so that mistakes are avoided
words.example: Please review the contract carefully before signing it.
words.chinese: 小心翼翼地；仔細地；謹慎地（強調細節和避免錯誤）

words.engDef: without enough attention, so mistakes are made
words.example: The report was submitted carelessly, and contained several factual errors.
words.chinese: 粗心大意地；不小心地（通常指工作或任務），可能導致錯誤或疏漏。

words.engDef: groups of things that share the same qualities
words.example: The marketing team needs to analyze sales data by product categories.
words.chinese: 類別；分類

words.engDef: to put things into groups by type
words.example: The marketing team needs to categorize all incoming leads based on their potential value.
words.chinese: 將…分類；歸類

words.engDef: carefully, so as to avoid risk or danger
words.example: The project manager approached the negotiation cautiously, considering the client's past behavior.
words.chinese: 小心翼翼地；謹慎地，以避免風險或意外

words.engDef: the main office that controls the other branches
words.example: All departmental heads must submit their quarterly reports to the central office by Friday.
words.chinese: 總辦公室；總部

words.engDef: difficult in a way that tests your ability
words.example: The project presented a challenging deadline, requiring the team to work overtime.
words.chinese: 具有挑戰性，困難的；需要付出努力的
words.rootPrefix: calumnia (a false accusation) -> to call someone out

words.engDef: a list of things to be done or confirmed
words.example: Before the meeting, please review the checklist to ensure all necessary documents are prepared.
words.chinese: 檢查清單；核對表，用以記錄需要完成或確認的事項。

words.engDef: decided to take one thing rather than another
words.example: After careful consideration, the committee chose the proposal from Apex Solutions.
words.chinese: 選擇；挑選

words.engDef: selected from a number of possibilities
words.example: The chosen candidate will receive a formal offer letter next week.
words.chinese: 被選擇的；選定的

words.engDef: arranged in the order in which things happened
words.example: The report should present the data in chronological order to show the project's progress.
words.chinese: 依照時間順序排列的；按年代次序的

words.engDef: large thick pieces, or separate parts of a whole
words.example: The project manager broke down the complex task into smaller chunks for easier management.
words.chinese: 大塊；塊狀物；（資料等）分段內容

words.engDef: the facts and conditions that affect a situation
words.example: Due to unforeseen circumstances, the meeting has been postponed until next week.
words.chinese: 情勢、情況（通常指影響決策或行動的外部因素）

words.engDef: a mention of the source of a quotation or fact
words.example: The report includes numerous citations to support its claims.
words.chinese: 引文；引用（來源）；學術論文的引用文獻

words.engDef: mentioned as the source of information or as an example
words.example: The report cited several studies to support its findings.
words.chinese: 引用；提及（來源或證據）

words.engDef: arranged into groups, or kept officially secret
words.example: The documents were classified according to their sensitivity level.
words.chinese: 歸類；將...分類；被歸類

words.engDef: a room where lessons or training take place
words.example: The training session will be held in the main classroom on the second floor.
words.chinese: 課堂；教室（通常指學校或公司進行教學或培訓的空間）

words.engDef: to make a place tidy and free of dirt
words.example: Please clean up your workspace before leaving the office.
words.chinese: 清理；收拾；恢復整潔

words.engDef: people or a company whose job is cleaning
words.example: The office manager hired new cleaners to ensure a spotless workspace.
words.chinese: 清潔人員；清潔公司

words.engDef: relating to office work, especially routine tasks
words.example: The administrative assistant is responsible for routine clerical tasks.
words.chinese: 文書的，辦公室職務的

words.engDef: in a careful and detailed way; very near
words.example: The team needs to monitor the project's progress closely to ensure it stays on schedule.
words.chinese: 密切地；仔細地；嚴格地

words.engDef: nearer in space, time, or relationship
words.example: Let's schedule a meeting with the client to get a closer look at their needs.
words.chinese: 更靠近；更接近；更密切

words.engDef: nearest of all
words.example: Please direct the client to the closest service center for faster assistance.
words.chinese: 最接近的；最近的（形容詞）

words.engDef: a lot of things left lying about untidily
words.example: The manager asked the staff to declutter their desks to improve efficiency.
words.chinese: 雜亂無章的物品堆積；混亂的狀態

words.engDef: to happen at the same time as something else
words.example: The project timeline coincides with the company's fiscal year-end.
words.chinese: 同時發生；一致；巧合
words.rootPrefix: co- (together) + in- (upon) + cid (to fall) -> to fall on the same spot

words.engDef: to happen at the same time as something else
words.example: The project deadline coincides with the company's annual review.
words.chinese: 與...同時發生；與...一致；與...重疊

words.engDef: to work together with others on a task
words.example: The marketing and sales teams need to collaborate closely to achieve the quarterly goals.
words.chinese: 合作；共同完成（任務、專案等）

words.engDef: the people you work with
words.example: I need to discuss this project with my colleagues before the meeting.
words.chinese: 同事；與你共事的人

words.engDef: as a group rather than separately
words.example: The team members need to work collectively to meet the project deadline.
words.chinese: 共同地；集體地

words.engDef: to make progress, or to arrive
words.example: The project is coming along nicely; we're on track to meet the deadline.
words.chinese: （逐漸）跟上；（進度）良好；（某人/某事）出現

words.engDef: to finally decide something
words.example: After a lengthy discussion, the board finally came to a decision regarding the new marketing strategy.
words.chinese: 做出決定；達成共識

words.engDef: to finish or stop
words.example: The contract will come to an end on December 31st.
words.chinese: 結束；終止（一段時期、活動或協議等）

words.engDef: to think of an idea or plan
words.example: The marketing team needs to come up with a new campaign to boost sales.
words.chinese: 提出（想法、計畫等）；想出

words.engDef: in a way that is pleasant and free from strain
words.example: The ergonomic chair allows employees to work comfortably for extended periods.
words.chinese: 舒適地，安穩地（表示狀態或動作的舒適程度）

words.engDef: to begin
words.example: The project will commence on January 1st, pending final approval.
words.chinese: 開始；著手（做某事）
words.rootPrefix: com- (together) + initiare (to begin) -> to begin together

words.engDef: property rented or bought for business use
words.example: The company is looking for commercial space in the city center to expand its operations.
words.chinese: 商業空間，通常指用於商業活動的租賃或購買的辦公室、零售店面或其他設施。

words.engDef: often; by most people
words.example: The company commonly uses email for internal communication.
words.chinese: 普遍地；通常地；常見地

words.engDef: the ways in which people or systems send information
words.example: The company is investing in new communication systems to improve efficiency.
words.chinese: 通訊；溝通（系統、流程或活動）

words.engDef: a collection of items gathered from different sources
words.example: The marketing team is working on a compilation of customer feedback to improve the product.
words.chinese: 彙整、編纂（指將多個來源的資訊或資料收集並整理成一個整體）

words.engDef: going well together so that each improves the other
words.example: The company offers complementary services to enhance customer satisfaction.
words.chinese: 互補的；補充的；相輔相成的

words.engDef: totally; in every way
words.example: The report needs to be reviewed completely before it's submitted to the board.
words.chinese: 完全地；徹底地

words.engDef: the finishing of a piece of work
words.example: The project manager confirmed the timely completion of the report.
words.chinese: 完成；竣工；結束

words.engDef: having many parts and difficult to understand
words.example: The new software system is quite complicated, and employees will need extensive training.
words.chinese: 複雜的；繁瑣的；不易理解的

words.engDef: made up of certain parts, or calm and in control
words.example: The team presented a well-composed proposal that impressed the board.
words.chinese: 由...組成；構成；沉著冷靜

words.engDef: writes or puts together a piece of work
words.example: The marketing team is currently composing a new promotional campaign for the upcoming holiday season.
words.chinese: 編寫；組成；構思

words.engDef: writing music or preparing a piece of text
words.example: The marketing team is currently composing a proposal for the new product launch.
words.chinese: （音樂）作曲；（文件、信件等）撰寫、編寫

words.engDef: pieces of music or writing that someone has created
words.example: The marketing team needs to review the compositions of the new advertising campaign.
words.chinese: 作品集；（音樂或文學）作品

words.engDef: the decisions reached after considering the facts
words.example: After careful analysis of the data, we reached the conclusion that sales will increase next quarter.
words.chinese: 結論；推論；最終判斷

words.engDef: proving something completely, so no doubt remains
words.example: The audit report provided conclusive evidence of financial irregularities.
words.chinese: 明確且有力的，能完全證明或確立某事物的；決定性的。

words.engDef: at the same time as something else
words.example: The project team is working concurrently on the marketing campaign and the product launch.
words.chinese: 同時地；並行地

words.engDef: made shorter by keeping only the important parts
words.example: The report was condensed to fit within the page limit.
words.chinese: 縮短、濃縮（內容或資訊），使之更精簡。

words.engDef: depending on something else happening first
words.example: The contract includes a conditional clause stating that payment is due upon successful completion of the project.
words.chinese: 條件；條件句；有條件的
words.rootPrefix: con- (together) + dic (to say) + -tion + -al -> what is said along with

words.engDef: a room used for meetings and presentations
words.example: The meeting will be held in the conference room on the third floor.
words.chinese: 會議室；用於公司會議、研討會或培訓的專用空間。

words.engDef: to disagree with or happen at the same time as something
words.example: The new policy conflicts with the company's long-standing ethical guidelines.
words.chinese: 與...發生衝突；與...不一致；與...相抵觸

words.engDef: to obey a rule or match a standard
words.example: All products must conform to the company's quality standards.
words.chinese: 符合；遵從；遵守（規定、標準等）

words.engDef: a word such as and or but that joins parts of a sentence
words.example: The project was delayed, but we are working hard to catch up.
words.chinese: 連接詞，用以連接詞、短語、子句或獨立分句，使語句結構更流暢。

words.engDef: as a result of what has just been said
words.example: The project was delayed due to unforeseen circumstances; consequently, the deadline has been extended.
words.chinese: 因此，相應地；結果

words.engDef: by a large amount
words.example: The company's profits increased considerably this quarter due to the new marketing campaign.
words.chinese: 相當地；顯著地；可觀地（表示程度，通常指數量、程度或變化）

words.engDef: to be made up of certain parts
words.example: The project team consists of five members from different departments.
words.chinese: 由...組成；包含

words.engDef: always in the same way over a long period
words.example: The company consistently meets its quarterly sales targets.
words.chinese: 持續地；穩定地；一貫地（指按照一定的規律或標準，長期保持不變）

words.engDef: the joining of several things into one stronger whole
words.example: The company's consolidation strategy helped streamline operations and reduce redundancy.
words.chinese: 整合

words.engDef: all the time, or very often
words.example: The project manager is constantly monitoring the team's progress to ensure deadlines are met.
words.chinese: 持續不斷地；持續地（指經常發生或存在）

words.engDef: the office abroad that helps citizens of its own country
words.example: The company's legal team advised them to register the trademark with the U.S. Consulate in Shanghai.
words.chinese: 領事館；領事機構，負責提供本國公民在海外的領事服務。

words.engDef: the things inside something, or a list of parts in a book
words.example: Please review the contents of the report before the meeting.
words.chinese: 內容；目錄；包含物

words.engDef: happening again and again over a long period
words.example: The company is continually seeking ways to improve its operational efficiency.
words.chinese: 持續不斷地；持續地（強調動作或狀態的持續性，且通常帶有重複或規律性）

words.engDef: without any break or interruption
words.example: The factory operates continuously for 24 hours a day to meet production targets.
words.chinese: 持續地；不斷地

words.engDef: in a way that is easy and suits your needs
words.example: The new office location is conveniently situated near the subway station.

words.engDef: on or from the outside of an organisation

words.engDef: to learn about something until you know it well

words.chinese: 填寫（表格、申請表等）；完成填寫

words.chinese: 最終定案；完成並確認

words.chinese: 查明； выяснить； 發現（真相、資訊等）

words.chinese: 首要優先順序；最重要的任務

words.engDef: the first action taken in a process

words.chinese: 首要步驟；初步行動

words.engDef: from your own direct experience

words.chinese: 直接的；第一手的；親身經歷的

words.chinese: 首先；第一，用於引導一系列步驟或論點。

words.chinese: 有缺陷的；有缺點的；不完美的

words.chinese: 完美無瑕的；沒有缺點的

words.engDef: a system of working with starting/finishing times chosen by the employee

words.chinese: 掙扎應付；手忙腳亂地應對（某事）

words.example: The marketing team needs to focus on increasing brand awareness in the Asian market.
words.chinese: 專注於；致力於；將注意力集中於

words.chinese: 摺疊；將某物彎曲或將其折疊起來。

words.chinese: 摺疊收納；將…摺疊起來

words.chinese: 文件夾；資料夾，用於整理和儲存文件。

words.engDef: with something coming immediately afterwards

words.chinese: 接著；隨後

words.engDef: the week after the one being talked about

words.chinese: 下週；未來一周

words.engDef: a note at the bottom of a page giving extra information
words.example: Please refer to the footnote at the bottom of the page for more information.
words.chinese: 腳註；補充說明；附註

words.chinese: 腳凳；讓腳部得以放鬆的矮凳，通常放置在辦公椅或沙發前方。

words.chinese: 為商業目的；為了商業活動

words.chinese: 目前；就目前而言

words.engDef: most important or best known

words.chinese: 首要的；最重要的；在最前面

words.engDef: failed to remember

words.chinese: 忘記；遺漏

words.engDef: in the past, but not now

words.chinese: 四十

words.chinese: 轉寄地址；郵件或信件的轉寄地址，通常用於員工離職或公司搬遷時使用。

words.chinese: 第四；四分之一

words.engDef: put in a frame, or presented in a particular way

words.chinese: 裝框的；以…為框架的；（問題、議題等）被框定的

words.chinese: 頻繁地；經常地（指時間上或程度上的高頻率）

words.engDef: the day after Thursday

words.chinese: 星期五，工作週的第五天，通常是週末前夕。
words.rootPrefix: Frige daeg (the day of Frigg, the Norse goddess)

words.engDef: starting at this moment
words.example: The new policy will be effective from now on.
words.chinese: 從現在開始；從此刻起

words.engDef: starting today and continuing after that
words.example: From this day onward, all project deadlines will be strictly enforced.
words.chinese: 從今天開始，之後便...

words.engDef: completely

words.chinese: 完全地；徹底地

words.engDef: the furniture and fittings that make a room usable

words.chinese: 家具及裝飾品（指為辦公室或住宅等空間配置的移動性物品）

words.engDef: sent so that you know about it, with no action needed

words.chinese: 僅供參考；供知悉

words.engDef: to collect things together from different places

words.engDef: an area where people can meet and talk together

words.chinese: 聚集空間；用於員工或參與者交流、討論或活動的區域。

words.engDef: usually; in most cases

words.chinese: 通常；一般而言

words.engDef: general rather than belonging to one particular brand
words.example: The company decided to use generic packaging to reduce costs.
words.chinese: 通用的；非特定品牌的；標準化的

words.engDef: to arrange a time to see someone
words.example: I need to get an appointment with the doctor to discuss my health concerns.
words.chinese: 預約（時間）；安排（約會）

words.engDef: to receive permission from someone in charge
words.example: The project proposal needs to get the manager's approval before it can proceed.
words.chinese: 獲得批准；得到認可

words.engDef: to be paid back money you have spent
words.example: Employees can get reimbursed for travel expenses up to a certain limit.
words.chinese: 獲得報銷；獲得費用補償

words.engDef: to remove something you no longer want

words.engDef: to become familiar with something over time

words.chinese: 往下樓；下樓

words.chinese: 向前推進；繼續進行；（比喻）繼續發展

words.engDef: to enter a place

words.engDef: to continue, or to happen
words.example: Let's go on with the meeting now that everyone is present.
words.chinese: 繼續進行；發生的；發生（某事）

words.engDef: to examine something carefully, or to experience it
words.example: The proposal needs to go through several revisions before it's approved by the board.
words.chinese: 經歷、審查、檢查、處理（某個程序或階段）

words.engDef: to suit each other or be done at the same time

words.chinese: 一同前往；互相配合；協同作業

words.engDef: moves or travels to a place

words.engDef: larger in size, amount, or importance

words.chinese: 更大的；程度更深；超過

words.engDef: very much

words.chinese: 大大地；顯著地；極大地（表示程度很高）

words.engDef: the colour between black and white

words.chinese: 灰色的；灰暗的；指介於黑色與白色之間的顏色，常用於描述物件的色調。

words.engDef: a card that allows a visitor to enter a building

words.chinese: 允許訪客進入公司或活動場所的通行證，通常具有時間限制。

words.engDef: rules or advice about how something should be done

words.chinese: 指導原則；規範

words.engDef: at or to the middle point

words.chinese: 在中間；在途中；一半

words.engDef: to give a completed piece of work to someone in charge

words.engDef: to give something to each person in a group

words.chinese: 分發（文件、傳單等）；發放（物品、資源等）

words.engDef: to give control or responsibility to someone else
words.example: The project manager needs to hand over the completed report to the CEO before the deadline.
words.chinese: 移交；交接；交付

words.engDef: a small book of instructions or rules

words.chinese: 手冊；指南（通常包含操作說明、政策或程序）

words.engDef: something annoying that takes time and effort

words.engDef: becomes stronger or more extreme

words.chinese: 加強、加劇、變得更加強烈

words.engDef: involving a lot of effort or resources in a short time
words.example: The company is offering an intensive training program for new employees.
words.chinese: 強烈的；集中的；密集的（指投入大量資源或時間以達到特定目標）

words.engDef: on purpose
words.example: The company released the software update intentionally to address the security vulnerability.
words.chinese: 故意地；蓄意地

words.engDef: between different departments of an organisation
words.example: The project requires close inter-department collaboration to ensure a smooth workflow.
words.chinese: 部門間的；跨部門的

words.engDef: to get involved in something in a way that causes problems
words.example: The construction noise interfered with our conference call.
words.chinese: 干擾；妨礙；影響
words.rootPrefix: inter- (between) + ferire (to strike) -> to strike in between

words.engDef: to prevent something from happening properly
words.example: The construction noise is interfering with our ability to concentrate on the project.
words.chinese: 干擾、妨礙（某事物正常進行）

words.engDef: temporary, used until a permanent one is ready
words.example: The interim manager will oversee the project until a permanent replacement is found.
words.chinese: 暫時的；過渡期的

words.engDef: at the middle level between beginner and advanced
words.example: This training program is designed for employees with an intermediate level of English proficiency.
words.chinese: 中級的；介於初級和高級之間

words.engDef: stopping and starting again at irregular times
words.example: The internet connection was intermittent during the video conference, causing disruptions.
words.chinese: 不時地；間歇性地

words.engDef: inside an organisation or a thing
words.example: The company decided to promote from within, hiring a new manager internally.
words.chinese: 在內部地；內在地；由內部產生地

words.engDef: between or among different countries
words.example: The company is expanding its operations internationally.
words.chinese: 在國際上；國際地

words.engDef: something that stops an activity for a short time
words.example: I apologize for the interruption, but I need to confirm a few details with my colleague.
words.chinese: 中斷；暫停，尤指在進行中時發生的短暫停止。

words.engDef: by natural feeling rather than careful thought
words.example: The project manager intuitively knew that the new strategy would be successful.
words.chinese: 憑直覺地；不需經過深思熟慮地

words.engDef: not legally or officially acceptable
words.example: The system flagged the invoice as invalid due to a missing account number.
words.chinese: 無效的；無效的資料或文件
words.rootPrefix: in- (not) + val (to be strong, from valere) + -id

words.engDef: to include something as a necessary part
words.example: This project involves a significant amount of research and development.
words.chinese: 包含、涉及、牽涉到
words.rootPrefix: in- (in) + volvere (to roll) -> to roll it up in

words.engDef: the act of taking part in something
words.example: The project requires significant involvement from all department heads.
words.chinese: 參與；投入；關涉

words.engDef: towards the inside
words.example: The company is focusing its resources inward to improve internal efficiency.
words.chinese: 向內；內向的；內部

words.engDef: not happening at even times, or not following the usual rules
words.example: The company announced that due to unforeseen circumstances, there would be some irregular working hours next week.
words.chinese: 非規則的，不規律的；不整齊的；不穩定的；不合規矩的

words.engDef: not connected with the matter being discussed
words.example: The information about the company's history is irrelevant to this project.
words.chinese: 不相關的；無關緊要的；與主題無關的

words.engDef: impossible to get back or put right
words.example: The company deemed the lost data irretrievable after the system failure.
words.chinese: 無法挽回的；無法找回的；永久喪失的

words.engDef: making you feel slightly angry or annoyed
words.example: The constant buzzing of the fluorescent lights was incredibly irritating during the meeting.
words.chinese: 令人煩躁的；惱人的；激怒的（指事物或行為），通常指持續或重複的困擾。

words.engDef: a subject people are discussing, or to send something out officially
words.example: The meeting will address several key issues related to the new project.
words.chinese: 問題；議題；發行（刊物、股票等）
words.rootPrefix: ex- (out) + ire (to go) -> to go out

words.engDef: the first month of the year
words.example: The annual budget review will take place in January.
words.chinese: 一月，農曆新年期間，通常是公司年度計畫審查和預算規劃的重要月份。
words.rootPrefix: Janus (the two-faced Roman god of doorways and beginnings)

words.engDef: strong cotton cloth, used mainly for trousers
words.example: The company's dress code allows employees to wear jeans on Fridays.
words.chinese: 牛仔褲；耐用的棉布服裝（通常指長褲）
words.rootPrefix: Genoa (the Italian city whose cotton cloth it was made from)

words.engDef: in order to be prepared if something happens
words.example: I'm bringing an umbrella just in case it rains later.
words.chinese: 以防萬一；預防措施

words.engDef: a good reason that explains why something was done
words.example: The manager requested a written justification for the budget increase.
words.chinese: 合理說明；辯護理由

words.engDef: with strong feeling or sharp attention
words.example: The marketing team is keenly aware of the changing consumer trends.
words.chinese: 敏銳地；強烈地；熱切地（形容詞，表示對某事抱有強烈的興趣或關注）

words.engDef: to keep telling someone the latest news about something
words.example: Please keep me informed of any changes to the project timeline.
words.chinese: 使…知情；通知…

words.engDef: to keep something supplied with the newest information
words.example: We need to keep our software up to date to ensure security.
words.chinese: 使...保持最新狀態；使...跟進最新資訊

words.engDef: to continue without stopping
words.example: The project is facing some challenges, but we need to keep going and meet the deadline.
words.chinese: 持續進行；繼續努力

words.engDef: to remember something when making a decision
words.example: Please keep in mind that the deadline for the project proposal is next Friday.
words.chinese: 牢記；記住；切記（重要資訊或要求）

words.engDef: to stay in control of work so nothing falls behind
words.example: It's crucial for project managers to keep on top of deadlines to ensure timely completion.
words.chinese: 跟上進度；掌握最新資訊；持續關注

words.engDef: to watch someone or something carefully
words.example: The security guard needs to keep an eye on the warehouse entrance to prevent theft.
words.chinese: 密切關注；留意；監視（某物或某人），確保其安全或狀態。

words.engDef: to make sure you know what is happening to something
words.example: The project manager needs to keep track of all team members' progress to ensure timely completion.
words.chinese: 追蹤、監控（進度、數據等），保持了解

words.engDef: continued to have or hold something
words.example: The company kept detailed records of all transactions for auditing purposes.
words.chinese: 保留；維持；保存

words.engDef: to stop work for the day, or to reduce a price
words.example: The manager announced that everyone could knock off early today due to the unexpected rain.
words.chinese: 停止工作；下班；（價格）降價

words.english: know A like the back of one’s hand
words.engDef: to know something extremely well
words.example: Our logistics team knows the city's distribution routes like the back of one’s hand, ensuring timely deliveries.
words.chinese: 非常熟悉；瞭若指掌（指對某事物或區域的知識非常深入，如同對自己手掌的熟悉程度）

words.engDef: marked with a label saying what something is
words.example: The documents were labeled with 'Confidential' to ensure privacy.
words.chinese: 標示；標籤；被標記的
words.rootPrefix: lambel (a narrow ribbon or strip, Old French)

words.engDef: a small computer you can carry and use anywhere
words.example: The IT department is providing each employee with a new laptop to improve productivity.
words.chinese: 筆記型電腦，便攜式電腦，適用於辦公和移動工作。

words.engDef: done or arranged at the latest possible time
words.example: We had a last-minute cancellation, so we have an extra room available.
words.chinese: 最後一刻的；緊急的；臨時的（通常指在截止期限或活動開始前短時間內發生的事情或安排）

words.engDef: the fact of arriving or happening after the expected time
words.example: The manager issued a warning about repeated lateness.
words.chinese: 遲到；遲延，延誤

words.engDef: the most recent piece of work someone has produced
words.example: The CEO is eager to review the team's latest work on the marketing campaign.
words.chinese: 最新作品；最新成果（通常指工作、研究或專案）

words.engDef: the ancient language of Rome
words.example: The document contains several Latin phrases that require translation.
words.chinese: 拉丁語；源自拉丁語的

words.engDef: to explain a plan clearly, or to arrange things in order
words.example: The manager asked the team to lay out the project timeline during the meeting.
words.chinese: 詳細說明、陳述、規劃、展現（計畫、資訊等）

words.engDef: to bring about a result step by step
words.example: The training program is designed to lead up to the final certification exam.
words.chinese: 逐漸引導、鋪墊至（某個結果或事件），通常指逐步提升或準備。

words.engDef: to bend the upper body backwards, usually to relax
words.example: After a long meeting, he leaned back in his chair and sighed.
words.chinese: 身體向後傾斜，通常表示放鬆或不正式的姿勢。

words.engDef: to let someone else decide or handle something
words.example: The manager decided to leave the scheduling up to her assistant.
words.chinese: 將...交由...決定；讓...自行處理

words.engDef: to put something in someone's care
words.example: The manager left the project with the senior team member to ensure its successful completion.
words.chinese: 將…留下給…；使…處於…狀態

words.engDef: formal talks given to teach a group of people
words.example: The CEO will deliver a lecture on the company's future strategy at the annual conference.
words.chinese: 演講、講座（通常為正式且結構化的內容）

words.engDef: clear enough to be read
words.example: The contract needs to be printed in a legible font so that all parties can easily review it.
words.chinese: 易於辨讀的；字跡清晰的

words.engDef: printed paper with a company's name and address at the top
words.example: Please print the official letter on company letterhead.
words.chinese: 信頭；帶有公司名稱、地址、標誌等資訊的信紙。

words.engDef: communication or cooperation which facilitates a close working relationship
words.example: She acts as a liaison between the marketing department and the design team.
words.chinese: 聯絡，聯絡人

words.engDef: a small device for lighting cigarettes; less heavy
words.example: Could you please lend me a lighter to light the candles?
words.chinese: 打火機；（較輕的）重量

words.engDef: gently and with little force
words.example: Please handle the fragile documents lightly to avoid damage.
words.chinese: 輕微地；不重地；以輕柔的方式

words.engDef: small in amount or restricted in some way
words.example: Due to budget constraints, our marketing campaign will have a limited scope this quarter.
words.chinese: 有限的；受限制的；數量或範圍有限

words.engDef: to form a queue, or to arrange things in a straight row
words.example: Please line up at the reception desk to collect your name badges.
words.chinese: 排隊；整齊排列

words.engDef: arranged in a straight line or in a fixed order
words.example: The project timeline was designed to be linear, with clear milestones for each phase.
words.chinese: 線性的；循序漸進的；按直線排列的

words.engDef: in the area near where you are
words.example: The company prefers to hire locally to support the community.
words.chinese: 在當地；在本地；局部的

words.engDef: the particular places where something is
words.example: Our company has several locations throughout the city, allowing us to serve a wider customer base.
words.chinese: 地點；位置（通常指多個地點或特定區域）

words.engDef: to shut yourself out by leaving the key inside
words.example: I locked myself out of the office this morning and had to call security to let me in.
words.chinese: 將自己鎖在門外；不小心將鑰匙留在外面，無法進入。

words.engDef: to try to find something
words.example: The HR department is looking for a qualified candidate to fill the vacant position.
words.chinese: 尋找；搜尋（某物或某人）

words.engDef: to feel pleased about something that will happen
words.example: We look forward to hearing from you soon regarding the project proposal.
words.chinese: 期待（某事發生），盼望

words.engDef: to examine a matter in order to find out the facts
words.example: The manager will look into the matter and provide a solution by the end of the week.
words.chinese: 調查；審查；仔細研究（某事）

words.engDef: to examine something quickly to check it
words.example: Before submitting the report, please look over it carefully for any typos or inconsistencies.
words.chinese: 審閱；仔細檢查（文件、報告等），通常是為了找出錯誤或提出建議。

words.engDef: to search for information in a book or system
words.example: Before finalizing the contract, please look up the legal precedents to ensure compliance.
words.chinese: 查詢（資料、資訊）；查閱（字典、詞典）；尋找（解決方案）

words.engDef: not tightly, or not exactly
words.example: The document was filed loosely in the cabinet, making it difficult to locate.
words.chinese: 鬆散地；不嚴謹地；隨意地

words.engDef: short for limited, used after a company's name
words.example: ABC Ltd. is a leading supplier of industrial equipment.
words.chinese: 有限公司（Limited），表示公司為股份有限公司，股東對公司債務的責任有限於其所持股額。

words.engDef: the part of the day when people eat lunch
words.example: Let's schedule a meeting after lunchtime.
words.chinese: 午餐時間；午休時間（通常指工作或學習期間的休息時間，專用於用餐）

words.engDef: a box where letters are delivered or posted
words.example: Please deposit the contract into the mailbox in the reception area.
words.chinese: 郵箱；信箱（用於接收郵件的容器）

words.engDef: for the most part
words.example: The company mainly focuses on developing sustainable energy solutions.
words.chinese: 主要地；大體上；主要地

words.engDef: to start doing something regularly
words.example: To improve employee wellness, the company encourages employees to make regular exercise a habit.
words.chinese: 使...成為例行習慣

words.engDef: to decide something after considering the facts
words.example: After analyzing the sales data, the marketing team was able to make a conclusion that the new campaign was successful.
words.chinese: 根據現有資訊做出判斷或結論；歸納出結論

words.engDef: to produce a duplicate of a document
words.example: Could you please make a copy of this report for the team?
words.chinese: 複製一份；製作副本

words.engDef: to change something so that it is right
words.example: Could you make a correction to the report before submitting it to the manager?
words.chinese: 指出並修正錯誤；修改

words.engDef: to choose what to do
words.example: After careful consideration, the management team needs to make a decision regarding the new marketing strategy.
words.chinese: 做出決定；決定

words.engDef: to make the last alteration before finishing
words.example: After reviewing the draft, please make a final change before submitting it to the manager.
words.chinese: 進行最後修改；完成最終調整

words.engDef: to do something wrongly
words.example: I made a mistake in the report, so I need to correct it before submitting.
words.chinese: 犯錯；出錯；做出錯誤判斷

words.engDef: to write something down so you remember it
words.example: Please make a note of the deadline for the project proposal.
words.chinese: 記錄下來；注意並記下

words.engDef: to take particular care to do something
words.example: Our company makes a point of providing excellent customer service to retain clients.
words.chinese: 特別注意、特別重視（做某事），刻意做到（某事）

words.engDef: to change a document to improve or correct it
words.example: The marketing team needs to make a revision to the presentation slides before the client meeting.
words.chinese: 修改；修正（文件、計畫等），以使其更準確或更完善。

words.engDef: to choose from a set of options
words.example: After reviewing all the candidates, the hiring manager will make a selection.
words.chinese: 從選項中挑選；做出選擇

words.engDef: to arrange a time to meet someone
words.example: I need to make an appointment with the doctor to discuss my health concerns.
words.chinese: 預約（時間）；安排（會議、諮詢等）

words.engDef: to plan the details of something in advance
words.example: Could you please make an arrangement for a meeting with the marketing team next week?
words.chinese: 安排；協調（行程、會議、約會等），通常涉及提前規劃和確認。

words.engDef: to do something wrongly
words.example: The auditor discovered several errors in the financial report.
words.chinese: 犯錯；出錯（指在工作或任務中出現錯誤）

words.engDef: to have no effect on the situation
words.example: The change in supplier will make no difference to the quality of our products.
words.chinese: 沒有影響；不造成差異

words.engDef: to create space for something or someone
words.example: We need to make room for the new marketing campaign in the budget.
words.chinese: 為...騰出空間；讓...有足夠的空間

words.engDef: to check that something is true or done
words.example: Please make sure all documents are signed before submitting them to the legal department.
words.chinese: 確保；務必，確定

words.engDef: to do something good that balances an earlier fault
words.example: The company offered a discount to make up for the delayed shipment.
words.chinese: 彌補；補償；抵消

words.engDef: to decide finally what to do
words.example: After reviewing the proposals, the committee needs to make up its mind about which vendor to choose.
words.chinese: 做出決定；下定決心

words.engDef: in a way that is very easy to notice
words.example: The company's profits increased markedly after the implementation of the new marketing strategy.
words.chinese: 明顯地；顯著地；可察覺地（表示程度或變化非常大）

words.engDef: the largest amount possible
words.example: The system can handle a maximum of 100 users simultaneously.
words.chinese: 最大值；最高限度

words.engDef: a voucher that lets an employee get a meal
words.example: The company offers employees a generous meal pass benefit to encourage healthy eating.
words.chinese: 員工餐券，允許員工在公司指定餐廳或合作餐廳享用餐點的憑證。

words.engDef: having a clear purpose or real importance
words.example: The manager emphasized the importance of creating meaningful projects for the team.
words.chinese: 有意義的；重要的；富含內涵的

words.engDef: intended something, or had a particular meaning
words.example: The company's policy meant that overtime work was mandatory during the peak season.
words.chinese: 意圖；打算；表示

words.engDef: the period of time until something else happens
words.example: We're working on the report; in the meantime, please review the preliminary data.
words.chinese: 在...期間；同時，此時

words.engDef: during the same period of time
words.example: The marketing team is developing a new campaign, meanwhile, the sales department is focusing on existing clients.
words.chinese: 同時；在...期間（表示兩個或多個事件同時發生或在某段時間內進行）

words.engDef: to finish work by the time it is due
words.example: We need to meet the deadline for this project to avoid penalties.
words.chinese: 在截止日期前完成任務或提交成果

words.engDef: to satisfy the conditions that are asked for
words.example: To secure the contract, our proposal must meet the client's requirements.
words.chinese: 符合規定或標準；達到要求

words.engDef: to be as good as the level demanded
words.example: Our new product must meet the industry's safety standards before it can be launched.
words.chinese: 符合標準；達到要求的

words.engDef: a short written message inside an organisation
words.example: Please read the memo regarding the upcoming company picnic.
words.chinese: 備忘錄；簡短的通知或訊息
words.rootPrefix: memorandum (a thing to be remembered, from memor mindful)

words.engDef: a book in which someone writes about their own life
words.example: The CEO's memoirs offer valuable insights into the company's strategic decisions over the past decade.
words.chinese: 回憶錄；自傳體回憶錄（通常由知名人士撰寫，記錄個人經歷與觀點）

words.engDef: a written message in business or diplomacy
words.example: The CEO issued a memorandum regarding the new remote work policy.
words.chinese: 備忘錄（常簡寫為 memo）

words.engDef: adult male people
words.example: The meeting room is reserved for men only.
words.chinese: 男性；男子

words.engDef: to spoil something or do it badly
words.example: We can't mess up this deal; it's crucial for the company's future.
words.chinese: 搞砸；出錯；弄亂（計畫、工作等）

words.engDef: made something untidy or spoiled it
words.example: I accidentally messed up the report with incorrect data.
words.chinese: 搞亂；弄糟；使混亂（通常指非故意的結果）
words.rootPrefix: missus (a course sent to the table, from mittere to send)

words.engDef: in the middle of a period or place
words.example: The company is currently in the mid-stage of its expansion plan.
words.chinese: 中期；中段；中間的

words.engDef: twelve o'clock in the day
words.example: The meeting is scheduled for midday to accommodate everyone's availability.
words.chinese: 中午；正午

words.engDef: short for minute or minimum
words.example: The meeting is scheduled for 30 mins.
words.chinese: 分鐘；極小的一段時間

words.engDef: keeping something in mind and paying careful attention
words.example: To improve productivity, employees are encouraged to practice mindful working techniques.
words.chinese: 專注於當下，有意識地覺察自身思緒、感受和行為，以提升工作效率和減少壓力。

words.engDef: very small of its kind
words.example: The company is launching a mini version of its popular laptop to appeal to students.
words.chinese: 小型；微型；小尺寸的

words.engDef: to the smallest degree possible
words.example: The company is trying to minimize costs, operating minimally to stay within budget.
words.chinese: 在最低限度上；盡可能少地

words.engDef: less the amount of; below zero
words.example: Ten minus three equals seven.
words.chinese: 減去；負的；缺點

words.engDef: the official written record of the meetings and discussions
words.example: The secretary took detailed minutes during the board meeting.
words.chinese: 會議記錄

words.engDef: made up of various different things
words.example: Please submit a list of miscellaneous expenses for reimbursement.
words.chinese: 各種零星的、不屬於同一類別的事物或項目。

words.engDef: to put something where you cannot find it again
words.example: I seem to have misplaced my presentation notes; could someone help me find them?
words.chinese: 將某物放置於不該放置的地方，或暫時找不到某物。
words.rootPrefix: mis- (wrongly) + platea (a broad street, from Greek platys broad)

words.engDef: a mistake in printed text
words.example: We need to reprint the brochures as there are several misprints on the first batch.
words.chinese: 印刷錯誤；誤印

words.engDef: because of a wrong belief; by mistake
words.example: The report was submitted with some figures mistakenly entered.
words.chinese: 錯誤地；錯誤地認為或做某事

words.engDef: a word that describes or limits another word
words.example: The company's marketing strategy needs a significant modifier to better target the younger demographic.
words.chinese: 修飾詞；限定詞，用來改變或限定其他詞語的意義。

words.engDef: for a very short time; in a moment
words.example: Please wait momentarily while I retrieve the document.
words.chinese: 暫時地；片刻間
words.rootPrefix: momentum (a movement, from movere to move) + -ary + -ly

words.engDef: lasting for a very short time
words.example: The system experienced a momentary outage, but it's back online now.

words.engDef: the day after Sunday

words.chinese: 星期一；週一

words.engDef: in addition to what has been said
words.example: The project was completed ahead of schedule; moreover, it was under budget.
words.chinese: 此外；而且；更進一步地

words.engDef: to go from one place to another
words.example: The company is planning to move its headquarters to a larger office space.
words.chinese: 移動；轉移；搬遷

words.engDef: to change position or go from place to place
words.example: During the conference, attendees are encouraged to move around and network with other professionals.
words.chinese: 在特定區域內移動或瀏覽，通常指非固定位置的活動。

words.engDef: to make progress with a plan

words.chinese: 向前推進；繼續進行；（計畫、討論等）繼續發展

words.engDef: to do several jobs at the same time
words.example: She's a highly efficient employee who can multitask effectively under pressure.
words.chinese: 同時處理多項任務，或在短時間內快速切換處理不同任務。

words.engDef: ordinary and not interesting
words.example: The daily routine can be quite mundane, but it's essential for maintaining efficiency.
words.chinese: 平淡乏味的；日常的；缺乏新意的

words.engDef: in a way that both sides share equally

words.chinese: 互相的；共同的

words.chinese: 姓名牌；身分證（通常用於識別員工或會議參與者）

words.engDef: the person officially appointed to act for others

words.chinese: 指定的代表；被授權代表

words.engDef: less wide than something else

words.chinese: 更窄的；比...更狹窄的

words.engDef: by only a small amount

words.chinese: 險些；幾乎，形容某事差點發生或達到某種狀態，通常帶有驚險或接近失敗的意味。

words.engDef: an official day off for the whole country
words.example: Please note that our office will be closed on the upcoming national holiday.
words.chinese: 全國性節日，指一個國家或地區官方認定的公共假期，通常與歷史事件、文化傳統或重要人物相關。

words.engDef: closest in distance or time
words.example: The nearest subway station is just a five-minute walk from the office.
words.chinese: 最近的；最接近的

words.engDef: the transfer of business processes to a nearby country
words.example: The European retailer chose nearshoring in Poland to maintain quick supply lines.
words.chinese: 鄰國外包，近岸外包

words.engDef: in a tidy and well-arranged way
words.example: Please arrange the documents neatly on your desk.
words.chinese: 整潔地；有條理地

words.engDef: in every case; as something that must be true
words.example: The project timeline is subject to change, and we can't necessarily guarantee completion by the deadline.
words.chinese: 不一定；不必然；表示某事不一定會發生，但可能發生。

words.engDef: a newly arranged time to meet someone
words.example: Please confirm the date and time of your new appointment with Mr. Lee.
words.chinese: 新的預約安排；新的約會。

words.engDef: very recently
words.example: The company is implementing a newly developed software to improve efficiency.
words.chinese: 新近的；剛開始的；最近才有的

words.engDef: a stall in the street that sells newspapers and magazines
words.example: I stopped by the newsstand to pick up a copy of the latest business journal.
words.chinese: 報刊攤；雜誌販售點

words.engDef: at the side of someone or something

words.chinese: 緊鄰；在...旁邊

words.engDef: the period of work during the night
words.example: Due to increased demand, we're offering overtime pay for employees working the night shift.
words.chinese: 夜班；夜間工作時段

words.engDef: able to move or think quickly and easily

words.chinese: 靈巧的；敏捷的，指動作或反應迅速。

words.engDef: the number 9
words.example: The office opens at nine in the morning.
words.chinese: 九

words.engDef: the number 90

words.chinese: 九十

words.engDef: by that time at the very latest
words.example: The report must be submitted no later than Friday.
words.chinese: 不遲於；在...之前（強調截止時間）

words.engDef: a beginning meaning not
words.example: The company has a non-disclosure agreement for all employees.
words.chinese: 不；沒有；否定的

words.engDef: the usual times when a business is open
words.example: Our normal operating hours are Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.
words.chinese: 標準營業時間

words.engDef: to make something become normal or standard
words.example: The company is working to normalize its operations after the recent supply chain disruption.
words.chinese: 使標準化；使符合常態；調整到正常水平

words.engDef: usually; in the way that is usual
words.example: The meeting is normally held on the first Tuesday of each month.
words.chinese: 通常地；一般而言

words.english: not only A but also B

words.example: The company not only provides excellent customer service but also offers competitive pricing.
words.chinese: 不僅...而且...

words.engDef: especially; in a way worth mentioning

words.chinese: 尤其地；值得注意的是

words.engDef: interesting or important enough to deserve attention
words.example: The company's recent sales figures are noteworthy, indicating a significant market growth.
words.chinese: 值得注意的；重要的；顯著的

words.engDef: a board where announcements are put up
words.example: Check the noticeboard for updates on the upcoming company picnic.
words.chinese: 公告欄；佈告欄（通常用於張貼公司內部通知、活動資訊等）

words.engDef: an official message telling you that something has happened
words.example: The system will send a notification when the payment is processed.
words.chinese: 通知；告知（通常指系統或應用程式發出的訊息，用以告知使用者相關資訊或事件）

words.engDef: an idea or belief about something
words.example: The company's notion of quality is to exceed customer expectations.
words.chinese: 觀念；概念；印象

words.engDef: the eleventh month of the year
words.example: The annual sales conference is scheduled for November 15th.
words.chinese: 十一月，公曆的第十一個月。
words.rootPrefix: novem (nine) -> the ninth month of the old Roman year

words.engDef: a person or thing that causes trouble or annoyance

words.chinese: 令人煩擾的事物或行為；困擾

words.engDef: quick to notice things around you
words.example: The manager is an observant leader who notices even the smallest changes in employee performance.
words.chinese: 細心的；善於觀察的；注意到細節的

words.engDef: watched or noticed something carefully

words.chinese: 觀察；注意到；察覺到

words.engDef: to think about something far too much

words.chinese: 過度關心或擔心某事，常因小事而困擾。

words.engDef: sometimes, but not often

words.chinese: 偶爾地，不時地（指發生頻率不高）

words.engDef: a slight possibility that something might happen
words.example: There's an off chance that the project might be delayed due to unforeseen circumstances.

words.engDef: not allowed to be entered or used
words.example: The executive suite is off-limits to all employees except for authorized personnel.
words.chinese: 禁止進入或使用；不在允許範圍內

words.engDef: the everyday materials used in an office, such as pens and paper

words.chinese: 辦公室用品，指辦公室日常使用之文具、耗材及其他輔助工具。

words.engDef: a plan that has been formally agreed
words.example: The company has an official arrangement with the supplier to ensure timely delivery of raw materials.
words.chinese: 正式安排；經正式確認的協議或計畫

words.engDef: in a way that is approved by an authority
words.example: The company announced the merger officially through a press release.
words.chinese: 正式地；依照規定地

words.engDef: to balance out the effect of something else
words.example: The company implemented a carbon offset program to reduce its environmental impact.
words.chinese: 抵消；補償；（時間、空間等）偏移

words.engDef: the practice of basing some of a company's processes or services overseas

words.chinese: 業務海外外包，離岸外包

words.engDef: something that has been left out
words.example: The report contained several omissions that needed to be corrected before submission.
words.chinese: 遺漏；省略（指未包含或未提及的事物）

words.engDef: away from your usual workplace for work reasons
words.example: Mr. Lee is currently on a business trip to Tokyo to attend a conference.
words.chinese: 因公出差

words.engDef: repeatedly at fixed intervals

words.chinese: 定期地；依照常態

words.engDef: once every week

words.chinese: 每週、按週進行

words.engDef: travelling or meeting for work purposes

words.chinese: 因公出差；為了商務目的

words.engDef: working during your official hours
words.example: The security guard is on duty at the front desk.
words.chinese: 值班的；在工作狀態的

words.engDef: nervous and unable to relax
words.example: The deadline is approaching, and everyone in the team is feeling on edge.
words.chinese: 緊張不安；處於高度警戒狀態

words.engDef: available and ready to be used
words.example: We have plenty of samples on hand to show potential clients.
words.chinese: 現成的；備有的；隨時可用的

words.engDef: sometimes, but not often
words.example: The CEO occasionally visits the branch offices to check on employee morale.
words.chinese: 偶爾；不時地

words.engDef: alone and without help
words.example: After the training, employees are expected to manage their projects on their own.
words.chinese: 獨立地；靠自己的；不需他人協助

words.engDef: deliberately, not by accident
words.example: He didn't spill the coffee; he did it on purpose to distract me.
words.chinese: 故意地；蓄意地

words.engDef: happening at the planned time
words.example: The project is on schedule and we expect to finish it by the end of the month.
words.chinese: 按時的；符合進度

words.engDef: ready to act as soon as you are needed
words.example: The technician is on standby to fix the equipment if needed.
words.chinese: 待命狀態；準備隨時待命

words.engDef: because someone advised it
words.example: The project was approved on the recommendation of the marketing department.
words.chinese: 根據…的建議；依照…的推薦

words.engDef: at the correct or arranged time
words.example: Please submit your expense report on time to ensure timely reimbursement.
words.chinese: 準時地；按時地

words.engDef: at the place where the work is being done
words.example: The technician will be on-site tomorrow to repair the equipment.
words.chinese: 在現場的；在工作地點的

words.engDef: the number 1; a single person or thing

words.chinese: 一;一個;單一的;某一;獨一無二的;人稱代詞:一個人;數字「一」;同類人或物中的一個

words.engDef: the different things you may choose
words.example: The company is exploring several options for expanding into the Asian market.
words.chinese: 選擇方案；可能性

words.engDef: usually; in normal circumstances
words.example: Ordinarily, the report is submitted by the end of the month.
words.chinese: 通常地；一般而言

words.engDef: arranged in a tidy and efficient way
words.example: The project manager kept all documents organized in a shared online folder.
words.chinese: 井然有序的；有條理的；組織良好的

words.engDef: people who plan and arrange an event
words.example: The event organizers are responsible for coordinating all logistics and ensuring a smooth conference.
words.chinese: 組織者；策劃者；活動規劃者

words.engDef: planning and arranging something
words.example: The project manager is responsible for organizing the team's tasks and deadlines.
words.chinese: 組織、安排；將事物按照特定方式整理。

words.engDef: aimed at or focused on something particular
words.example: Our company is customer-oriented, focusing on providing excellent service.
words.chinese: 以…為中心；注重…；朝向…

words.engDef: at the beginning, before any change
words.example: The company's headquarters were originally located in a smaller town.
words.chinese: 最初地；原本地；起初

words.engDef: having no paper left
words.example: I'm afraid we're out of paper in the printer. Could someone restock it, please?
words.chinese: 缺紙；沒有紙張可用

words.engDef: no longer current or useful
words.example: The company's software is out-of-date and needs to be updated immediately.
words.chinese: 過時的；不再適用的；已失效的

words.engDef: clothes such as coats worn over other clothes

words.chinese: 外衣；穿在最外面的衣物（通常指用於保暖或防風的服裝）

words.engDef: described the main points of something

words.chinese: 概述；勾勒出輪廓；簡要說明

words.engDef: descriptions of the main points; the outer shapes of things
words.example: Before starting the project, please outline the key objectives and deliverables.
words.chinese: 概述；大綱；輪廓

words.engDef: not paid or returned by the time it was due
words.example: The report was overdue by a week, causing delays in the project.
words.chinese: 逾期未交；過期未繳

words.engDef: too; more than is suitable
words.example: The report was overly detailed and included unnecessary information.
words.chinese: 過度的；過多的，不必要的

words.engDef: larger than the usual size
words.example: The client returned the oversized suit because it didn't fit properly.
words.chinese: 過大的；尺寸過於寬敞的
words.rootPrefix: over- (too much) + assise (a sitting, a settled measure, Old French)

words.engDef: a short description of the main points
words.example: Let's start with a brief overview of the project's current status.
words.chinese: 總覽；簡要概述；摘要

words.engDef: so great that it is difficult to deal with
words.example: The amount of paperwork required for this project is overwhelming.
words.chinese: 壓倒性的；令人不堪重負的；過多的

words.engDef: because of
words.example: The meeting was postponed owing to unforeseen circumstances.
words.chinese: 由於；因為（表示原因或理由，通常帶有負面或不愉快的意味）

words.engDef: to put things into boxes or storage
words.example: Before leaving for the weekend, please pack away all sensitive documents in the filing cabinet.
words.chinese: 將物品收納、整理起來，尤其是將物品放入儲藏空間。

words.engDef: soft pieces of material used for protection or writing

words.chinese: 墊片；緩衝墊；（電腦）滑鼠墊

words.engDef: with a great deal of care and effort
words.example: The team painstakingly reviewed the contract to ensure accuracy.
words.chinese: 費時費力地；極度謹慎地

words.engDef: the routine written work of an office
words.example: The new employee spent the first week completing a lot of paperwork.
words.chinese: 文牘、文件（通常指大量且重複性的行政或公司文件）

words.engDef: partly; not completely
words.example: The project was completed partially due to unforeseen delays.
words.chinese: 部分地；不完全地

words.engDef: especially; more than usual
words.example: The report highlights the company's performance, particularly in the Asian market.
words.chinese: 尤其地；特別地（強調某事物在眾多事物中更為突出）

words.engDef: to give something to each person in turn
words.example: Please pass around the draft report for review by Friday.
words.chinese: （文件、資訊等）傳閱；散播；分享

words.engDef: to ignore someone or something rather than choosing it
words.example: The manager decided to pass over several candidates and promote Sarah to the position.
words.chinese: 忽略；跳過（某事物或某人），通常指未經考慮或未經處理。

words.engDef: to do something so that time goes by less slowly
words.example: While waiting for the meeting to start, I like to pass the time by reading industry news.
words.chinese: 消磨時間；度過一段時間（通常指無聊或等待時的活動）

words.engDef: to refuse a chance or offer
words.example: Don't pass up this opportunity to network with industry leaders.
words.chinese: 錯過、捨棄（機會、優惠等），不接受（提議、邀請等）

words.engDef: without taking action or resisting
words.example: Employees should not passively accept changes; they should actively participate in the discussion.
words.chinese: 被動地；不主動地；消極地

words.engDef: to pull a thin layer away from a surface
words.example: Please peel off the price tag before displaying the merchandise.
words.chinese: （貼紙、標籤等）撕除；（油漆、塗層等）剝落

words.engDef: for each day
words.example: The daily rental fee is $50 per day.
words.chinese: 每天；每日

words.engDef: able to be noticed or felt
words.example: The slight difference in color was barely perceptible to the untrained eye.
words.chinese: 可察覺的；明顯的；能被感知的

words.engDef: quick to notice and understand things
words.example: The manager is a perceptive leader who quickly identifies potential problems.
words.chinese: 洞察力敏銳的；善於察覺細微之處的；具有良好判斷力的。
