words.engDef: completely, with nothing wrong
words.example: The report was executed perfectly, exceeding all expectations.
words.chinese: 完全地；完美地（表示達到最高標準或期望）

words.engDef: carried out a task, or gave a public show
words.example: The team performed exceptionally well during the quarterly review.
words.chinese: 執行；展現；呈現（某項任務、技能或表演）

words.engDef: carries out a task or duty
words.example: The marketing team performs market research to identify potential customers.
words.chinese: 執行；展現；呈現；完成（任務或職責）

words.engDef: happening again at regular intervals
words.example: The company conducts periodic performance reviews for all employees.
words.chinese: 週期的；定期的

words.engDef: a magazine or journal published at regular intervals
words.example: The company distributes a quarterly periodical to keep employees updated on recent developments.
words.chinese: 定期發行的刊物，例如雜誌、期刊或報告，通常以特定時間間隔發行。

words.engDef: from time to time at fairly regular intervals
words.example: The company updates its website periodically to reflect new product information.
words.chinese: 週期性地；不時地；定期地（但間隔時間不固定）

words.engDef: for all time; without changing back
words.example: The company has decided to relocate its headquarters permanently.
words.chinese: 永久地；不變地（表示狀態或情況不會改變）

words.engDef: officially allowed
words.example: Employees are permitted to use the company's gym during their lunch break.
words.chinese: 允許；被准許

words.engDef: continuing firmly in spite of difficulty
words.example: The sales team's persistent follow-up resulted in a significant increase in sales.
words.chinese: 持續不斷的；堅持不懈的

words.engDef: to lose water through the skin when hot or nervous
words.example: He was perspiring heavily during the presentation due to nervousness.
words.chinese: （因緊張、疲勞或高溫）冒汗；流汗
words.rootPrefix: per- (through) + spir (to breathe) -> to breathe out through the skin

words.engDef: relating to a particular subject
words.example: The report contains information pertaining to the company's financial performance.
words.chinese: 與…相關的；關於…的
words.rootPrefix: per- (thoroughly) + tain (to hold, from tenere) -> to hold through to

words.engDef: relating to a particular subject
words.example: The report focuses on issues pertaining to employee safety.
words.chinese: 與…相關的；關於…的

words.engDef: directly connected with the matter being discussed
words.example: Please focus on the pertinent details in the report and disregard the irrelevant information.
words.chinese: 相關的；切題的；與主題相關的

words.engDef: a machine that makes paper copies of documents
words.example: Could you please make a few copies of this report on the photocopier?
words.chinese: 影印機；複印機，用於複製文件。

words.engDef: a copy of a document made by a machine
words.example: Could you please photocopy these documents for the meeting?
words.chinese: 影印文件；影印複本

words.engDef: relating to the body or to material things
words.example: The employee was unable to complete the task due to a physical limitation.
words.chinese: 從身體或生理層面的；實際的，具體的

words.engDef: to collect your wages in person
words.example: I usually pick up my paycheck from the HR department on Fridays.
words.chinese: 領取薪資（支票或現金）；拿到工資單

words.engDef: one part at a time
words.example: We're assembling the new product piece by piece to ensure quality control.
words.chinese: 逐步地；逐一地；分段地

words.engDef: to increase and gather in a heap or backlog
words.example: The backlog of emails is piling up, and we need to prioritize clearing them.
words.chinese: 累積；堆積（通常指數量或問題不斷增加）

words.engDef: a book or program for organising your schedule
words.example: The project manager uses a detailed planner to track deadlines and allocate resources.
words.chinese: 計畫表；規劃者，通常指用於安排行程、任務或活動的工具。

words.engDef: seeming reasonable and likely to be true
words.example: The consultant presented a plausible explanation for the company's declining profits.
words.chinese: 看似合理或可信的；似乎有根據的
words.rootPrefix: plaudere (to clap, to applaud) + -ible -> worth clapping for

words.engDef: a large enough amount
words.example: We have plenty of time to finish the project before the deadline.
words.chinese: 充足的；大量的；充裕的

words.engDef: more than enough of something
words.example: We have plenty of time to finish the project before the deadline.
words.chinese: 充足的；大量的（指數量或程度），足以滿足需求。

words.engDef: the main events of a story; small pieces of land
words.example: The marketing team is analyzing sales plots to identify trends.
words.chinese: （故事、情節、計畫）情節；圖表；圖形

words.engDef: a beginning meaning many
words.example: The company's poly-lingual staff can effectively communicate with clients worldwide.
words.chinese: 多數的；由許多組成。

words.engDef: badly; not to a good standard
words.example: The project was poorly managed, resulting in significant delays and budget overruns.
words.chinese: 不佳地；差勁地；令人失望地（通常指表現或品質不符合期望）

words.engDef: a painting or photograph of a person
words.example: The company's website features a professional portrait of the CEO.
words.chinese: 肖像畫；人像照片
words.rootPrefix: por- (forth) + trait (to draw, from trahere) -> drawn forth onto paper

words.engDef: to put up an announcement on a board or wall
words.example: The HR department will post a notice on the bulletin board regarding the upcoming training sessions.
words.chinese: 張貼公告於...

words.engDef: to move something to a later time
words.example: Due to unforeseen circumstances, we have to postpone the project launch until next month.
words.chinese: 延遲；將...推遲到以後
words.rootPrefix: post- (after) + pon (to put) -> to put it off till later

words.engDef: to delay something to a stated later time
words.example: We need to postpone the meeting until next Tuesday due to unforeseen circumstances.
words.chinese: 將...延遲到...時間

words.engDef: possibly, if things develop in a certain way
words.example: The company is exploring potentially lucrative markets in Southeast Asia.
words.chinese: 潛在的；或許會發生的

words.engDef: useful and likely to work in real situations
words.example: The company is looking for practical solutions to reduce operational costs.
words.chinese: 切合實際的；可操作的；實用的
words.rootPrefix: praktikos (fit for doing, Greek, from prassein to do) + -al

words.engDef: almost; also in a realistic way
words.example: The new software is designed to streamline the workflow and make tasks practically effortless.
words.chinese: 實際上；幾乎
words.rootPrefix: praktikos (fit for doing, Greek, from prassein to do) + -ally

words.engDef: a beginning meaning before
words.example: The marketing team needs to prepare a pre-launch campaign to generate initial buzz.
words.chinese: 預先；事先

words.engDef: exactly and with no room for error
words.example: Please specify the delivery date precisely in your order.
words.chinese: 精確地；確切地；準確地（強調細節和無誤）

words.engDef: in the way that was expected
words.example: The project timeline was adhered to predictably, ensuring timely completion.
words.chinese: 可預期地；依照預期地

words.engDef: mostly; mainly
words.example: The company's revenue is predominantly derived from overseas sales.
words.chinese: 主要地；以…為主的；大體上

words.engDef: if possible, this is the better choice
words.example: We would prefer to receive the report by email rather than by mail.
words.chinese: 較好地；寧願

words.engDef: the things you like more than others
words.example: The survey aims to identify customer preferences regarding product features.
words.chinese: 偏好；選擇；喜好

words.engDef: to get something ready
words.example: The marketing team is prepping the presentation for the upcoming conference.
words.chinese: 準備；預備（尤指為某事做準備）

words.engDef: the work done to get ready for something
words.example: The marketing team is in full preparation for the product launch next month.
words.chinese: 準備工作；預備措施（指為特定目的而進行的行動或安排）

words.engDef: at the present time; soon
words.example: We are presently reviewing the proposal and will provide feedback by Friday.
words.chinese: 目前；現今；當下（表示時間上的現在）

words.engDef: needing to be dealt with at once
words.example: The manager emphasized that the deadline for the project is a pressing matter.
words.chinese: 緊急且需要立即處理的；迫切的

words.engDef: common and widespread in a place or group
words.example: The use of remote work has become increasingly prevalent in the tech industry.
words.chinese: 普遍存在的；盛行的（指某種現象、觀點或行為在特定群體或地區中廣泛存在）
words.rootPrefix: pre- (before) + val (to be strong, from valere) + -ent -> stronger than the rest

words.engDef: coming before the present one
words.example: Please refer to the previous report for more details.
words.chinese: 先前的；之前的
words.rootPrefix: pre- (before) + via (a way) + -ous -> going before on the road

words.engDef: at an earlier time
words.example: The company's financial performance was significantly better previously compared to this quarter.
words.chinese: 先前；過去

words.engDef: mainly; for the most part
words.example: The company primarily focuses on developing sustainable energy solutions.
words.chinese: 主要地；首要地；以...為主要目的

words.engDef: to produce a paper copy from a computer
words.example: Could you please print out the report for the meeting?
words.chinese: 列印出來；將資料以紙本形式輸出

words.engDef: to decide which things should be done first
words.example: The project manager needs to prioritize tasks based on their deadlines and importance.
words.chinese: 將某事視為優先順序；確定優先處理事項

words.engDef: something that must be dealt with before other things
words.example: Our top priority is to ensure customer satisfaction.
words.chinese: 優先順序；首要任務

words.engDef: the state of being free from public attention
words.example: The company is committed to protecting the privacy of its customers' personal data.
words.chinese: 隱私權；不公開的狀態

words.engDef: not in front of other people
words.example: The company held a private meeting to discuss the merger.
words.chinese: 私下地；隱私地；非公開地

words.engDef: likely to happen or be true
words.example: It is probable that the shipment will be delayed due to the severe weather conditions.
words.chinese: 很有可能；極有可能

words.engDef: causing difficulty or doubt
words.example: The new software has several problematic bugs that need to be addressed immediately.
words.chinese: 構成問題或困難的；令人擔憂的

words.engDef: the accepted order of steps for doing something
words.example: Please follow the standard procedure for submitting expense reports.
words.chinese: 程序；步驟；操作流程

words.engDef: to continue with what has been started
words.example: Let's proceed with the next agenda item.
words.chinese: 繼續進行；按計畫進行

words.engDef: to keep putting off something you should do
words.example: He tends to procrastinate on important projects, which often leads to missed deadlines.
words.chinese: 延遲處理；拖延（任務或責任）
words.rootPrefix: pro- (forward) + cras (tomorrow) + -ate -> to put it off till tomorrow

words.engDef: getting a lot of useful work done
words.example: The new software has significantly increased our team's productivity.
words.chinese: 有成效的；能產生結果的；能有效利用時間或資源的

words.engDef: in a way that achieves a lot of useful work
words.example: The new software allows employees to work more productively.
words.chinese: 高效地；富有成效地

words.engDef: relating to a job that needs special training and skill
words.example: The company hired a professional translator for the important contract.
words.chinese: 具有專業技能或知識，並以此為職業的人或事物。

words.engDef: a senior teacher at a university
words.example: The professor will present the research findings at the upcoming conference.
words.chinese: 大學或學院的教授，通常具有專業知識和豐富的教學經驗。

words.engDef: skilled and able to do something well
words.example: She is proficient in Microsoft Excel and can create complex spreadsheets.
words.chinese: 精通的；熟練的，在某領域具有高超技能。

words.engDef: continuing for a long time
words.example: The project experienced a prolonged delay due to unforeseen circumstances.
words.chinese: 延長的；持續的；冗長的

words.engDef: important and widely known
words.example: The company's logo is prominently displayed on all marketing materials.
words.chinese: 顯著的；傑出的；重要的（通常指地位、影響力或知名度）
words.rootPrefix: pro- (forward) + min (to jut, from minere) + -ent -> jutting out in front

words.engDef: to cause someone to do or say something
words.example: The software prompts the user to enter their password.
words.chinese: 提示；引導；啟動
words.rootPrefix: pro- (forth) + emere (to take) -> brought forth at once

words.engDef: quickly and without delay
words.example: The delivery service promised to ship the order promptly.
words.chinese: 立即地；迅速地（指在預期或要求的時間內），通常用於強調行動的及時性。

words.engDef: the quality of doing things quickly and on time
words.example: The manager emphasized the importance of promptness in responding to client emails.
words.chinese: 準時性；及時性，特指在約定的時間內準時完成任務或回應。

words.engDef: facts or evidence showing that something is true
words.example: The contract requires solid proof of insurance coverage before it can be signed.
words.chinese: 證據；證明；確鑿的資料
words.rootPrefix: probare (to test, to find good, from probus upright)

words.engDef: to read a text carefully to correct mistakes
words.example: Before submitting the report, please proofread it carefully for any typos or grammatical errors.
words.chinese: 校對；仔細檢查（文件、文章等）以找出並修正錯誤。

words.engDef: correctly and in a suitable way
words.example: Please ensure all documents are labeled properly before filing.
words.chinese: 適當的；正確的；恰當的

words.engDef: a person who publicly supports an idea or plan
words.example: The company's CEO is a strong proponent of remote work and flexible hours.
words.chinese: 支持者；倡導者
words.rootPrefix: pro- (forth) + pon (to put) + -ent -> the one who puts it forward

words.engDef: a formal written plan put forward for others to consider
words.example: The marketing team submitted a proposal for a new advertising campaign.
words.chinese: 提案；建議方案（通常為書面形式，用於正式提出某項計畫或建議）

words.engDef: relating to an owner or ownership; protected by patent or copyright
words.example: The brand developed proprietary software that competitors cannot copy.
words.chinese: 專利的，專有的

words.engDef: the advantages and disadvantages of something
words.example: Before making a decision, let's weigh the pros and cons of each proposal.
words.chinese: 優點與缺點；利弊分析

words.engDef: the official rules for how something should be done
words.example: The company's new protocol initiative exceeded expectations in the first quarter.
words.chinese: 協議
words.rootPrefix: proto- (first) + kolla (glue, Greek) -> the first sheet glued to a scroll

words.engDef: shown by evidence to be true or effective
words.example: The company's success is a proven track record of innovation and customer satisfaction.
words.chinese: 經證實的；已獲得驗證的；確鑿的

words.engDef: only if this condition is met
words.example: The company will provide training to all new employees, provided they complete the onboarding process.
words.chinese: （在特定條件下）提供、供給；（若...的話）

words.engDef: nearness in space or time
words.example: The office is located in close proximity to the subway station, making it convenient for employees.
words.chinese: 接近程度；鄰近性

words.engDef: the authority to represent someone else, especially in voting
words.example: Shareholders who cannot attend the meeting can cast their votes by proxy.
words.chinese: 代理權，代理人

words.engDef: an official day when most people do not work
words.example: Please note that our office will be closed on the public holiday.
words.chinese: 法定假日，通常指政府或公司規定不需上班或上課的日子。

words.engDef: a library open to everyone, paid for by public money
words.example: The company encourages employees to utilize the public library for research and professional development.
words.chinese: 公共圖書館：由政府或非營利機構營運，向公眾開放的圖書館，提供書籍、期刊、數位資源等資訊服務。

words.engDef: a book, magazine, or report that has been printed
words.example: The company's latest publication highlights its commitment to sustainability.
words.chinese: 出版物；發行物（通常指書籍、雜誌、報紙等）
words.rootPrefix: publicus (of the people, from populus the people) + -ation

words.engDef: to produce a book or make information available to the public
words.example: The company plans to publish its quarterly earnings report next week.
words.chinese: 發布；公佈（資訊、報告等）
words.rootPrefix: publicus (of the people) + -ish -> to make it public

words.engDef: a company or person that produces books or magazines
words.example: The publisher is seeking manuscripts for their upcoming business journal.
words.chinese: 出版商；發行人（通常指書籍、雜誌等）

words.engDef: to lower something, or to demolish a building
words.example: The company decided to pull down the old warehouse to make way for a new office building.
words.chinese: 將...拉下；降低（價格、數量等）；拆除（結構）

words.engDef: to remove something, or to withdraw from an agreement
words.example: The company decided to pull out of the joint venture due to financial difficulties.
words.chinese: 從（某物）中拉出；（車輛）駛出（某處）；（計畫、提案等）退出

words.engDef: to hit with a closed hand, or to make a hole in paper
words.example: He punched in his employee ID to access the system.
words.chinese: （用拳頭）打；（電腦）鍵入，輸入

words.engDef: arriving or happening at exactly the right time
words.example: It's important to be punctual for meetings to show respect for others' time.
words.chinese: 守時的；準時的
words.rootPrefix: punctum (a point) + -ual -> exact to the point of time

words.engDef: at exactly the arranged time
words.example: Please submit your expense reports punctually to ensure timely reimbursement.
words.chinese: 準時地；按時地（強調遵守時間表或約定）

words.engDef: not mixed with anything else
words.example: The company prides itself on using pure ingredients in its products.
words.chinese: 純粹的；未經摻雜的；絕對的

words.engDef: a small bag for money or personal items
words.example: She reached into her purse to find her wallet.
words.chinese: 錢包；手提包；財政；獎金
words.rootPrefix: bursa (a leather bag, Greek byrsa a hide)

words.engDef: to move something to a later time, or to resist a plan
words.example: The project deadline was pushed back due to unforeseen circumstances.
words.chinese: 延遲、推遲（時間、日期、會議等）；反對、抵制（提議、計畫等)

words.engDef: to force a way forward through a crowd or difficulty
words.example: During the busy trade show, attendees often have to push their way through the crowds to reach the booths.
words.chinese: 強行擠過；憑藉毅力突破重重阻礙

words.engDef: to ask for something to be done more quickly than usual
words.example: We need to put a rush on this order to ensure it arrives before the conference.
words.chinese: 催促；加快處理速度

words.engDef: to put things back in the place where they are kept
words.example: Please put away the documents in the filing cabinet after the meeting.
words.chinese: 收納、歸位；將物品放置於指定位置

words.engDef: to place something on a surface, or to write it down
words.example: Please put down your name and employee ID on the attendance sheet.
words.chinese: 放下；記錄；批評（貶義）；停止（某項活動）

words.engDef: to offer an idea or suggestion for consideration
words.example: The marketing team needs to put forth a new strategy to increase brand awareness.
words.chinese: 提出（想法、建議、計畫等），努力嘗試

words.engDef: to install something, or to spend time on work
words.example: Please put the report on my desk before the meeting.
words.chinese: 投入；放置；安裝；（資料）輸入

words.engDef: to arrange things in the correct sequence
words.example: Could you please put the documents in order on your desk?
words.chinese: 整理歸位；將...按順序擺放

words.engDef: to work extra hours beyond the normal schedule
words.example: Due to the approaching deadline, several team members had to put in some overtime this week.
words.chinese: 加班；額外工作

words.engDef: to delay something until later
words.example: We had to put off the meeting due to a scheduling conflict.
words.chinese: 延遲、推遲（某事）；將...延後

words.engDef: to dress in something, or to switch a device on
words.example: Please put on your name badge before entering the conference room.
words.chinese: 穿戴（衣服、飾品等）；開啟（燈、電視等）

words.engDef: to accept something unpleasant without complaining
words.example: I can't put up with his constant complaining anymore; we need to address this issue.
words.chinese: 容忍；忍受（不愉快的情況或行為）

words.engDef: a group of four; a square courtyard
words.example: The company is investing in a new quad-core processor to improve system performance.
words.chinese: 四個；由四個部分組成的

words.engDef: has the right training or meets the necessary conditions
words.example: To qualify for the promotion, employees must have at least five years of experience.
words.chinese: 符合資格；達到標準；勝任

words.engDef: possibly not honest, correct, or of good quality
words.example: The company's accounting practices are questionable and require further investigation.
words.chinese: 可疑的；值得質疑的；品質或可靠性令人懷疑的。

words.engDef: a line of people waiting for their turn
words.example: Employees are asked to queue up for their ID badges after the security check.
words.chinese: 排隊；隊伍
words.rootPrefix: cauda (a tail) -> a line trailing like a tail

words.engDef: fast; in a short time
words.example: The report needs to be completed quickly to meet the deadline.
words.chinese: 迅速地；快速地（表示動作或完成某事的速度很快）

words.engDef: without making much noise
words.example: Please complete the report quietly so as not to disturb your colleagues.
words.chinese: 安靜地；悄悄地

words.engDef: the minimum number of members that must be present at a meeting
words.example: We cannot proceed with the vote because we have not reached a quorum.
words.chinese: 法定人數

words.engDef: whatever the weather; whatever happens
words.example: We're committed to delivering the project on time, rain or shine.
words.chinese: 無論天氣如何，無論好壞，持續進行或完成。

words.engDef: without any plan or pattern
words.example: The survey participants were selected randomly from the company's database.
words.chinese: 隨機地；不按特定順序或模式
words.rootPrefix: randir (to run fast, to gallop, Old French) + -ly

words.engDef: very quickly
words.example: The company is expanding its operations rapidly to meet the increasing demand.
words.chinese: 迅速地；快速地（指速度或程度的快速變化）
words.rootPrefix: rapidus (tearing away, from rapere to seize) + -ly

words.engDef: not often
words.example: The company rarely offers discounts on its premium products.
words.chinese: 很少地；不常地

words.engDef: to decide something after considering the facts
words.example: After analyzing the data, the team was able to reach a conclusion about the project's feasibility.
words.chinese: 得出結論；歸納出結論

words.engDef: to stretch out your hand to get something
words.example: He reached for the report on his desk to review the latest sales figures.
words.chinese: 伸手去拿；試圖獲得（某物或機會）

words.engDef: a person who reads
words.example: The company is looking for skilled readers to review and approve marketing materials.
words.chinese: 閱讀者；讀者，通常指閱讀商業文件或報告的人。

words.engDef: quickly and willingly; easily available
words.example: The documents are readily available for review on the shared drive.
words.chinese: 隨時可得的；樂於提供的；輕而易舉的

words.engDef: in a way that takes the real situation into account
words.example: We need to assess the project's feasibility realistically, considering the current budget constraints.
words.chinese: 現實地；切合實際地，顧及實際情況地

words.engDef: to change the order or position of things
words.example: The manager asked the staff to rearrange the files alphabetically.
words.chinese: 重新排列；重新安排

words.engDef: in a fair and sensible way; to a fair degree
words.example: The project budget needs to be adjusted to reflect the current market conditions reasonably.
words.chinese: 合理地；適當地；在可接受的範圍內

words.engDef: not long ago
words.example: The company has recently expanded its operations into Southeast Asia.
words.chinese: 最近，近來，近期（指時間上接近現在）

words.engDef: a short break in work or in an official meeting
words.example: The manager announced a 15-minute recess for all employees to refresh themselves.
words.chinese: 暫停（工作或活動），休息時間
words.rootPrefix: re- (back) + cess (to go) -> a going back, a break

words.engDef: given and received equally by both sides
words.example: The company offered a reciprocal discount to its suppliers.
words.chinese: 互惠的；相互的；雙向的，指雙方互相提供或交換利益。

words.engDef: known or officially accepted as valid
words.example: The company's brand is now widely recognized in the international market.
words.chinese: 被認可；被承認；被識別

words.engDef: something you remember, or the act of remembering
words.example: The manager asked the employee to share his recollection of the meeting.
words.chinese: 回憶；記憶；對過去事件的追憶
words.rootPrefix: re- (again, back) + col- (together) + lect (to gather, from legere) + -ion

words.engDef: suggested as good or suitable
words.example: The consultant recommended a new software solution to improve efficiency.
words.chinese: 推薦；建議（通常基於專業判斷或經驗）

words.engDef: the act of thinking about a decision again
words.example: After reviewing the proposal, the committee decided to postpone a decision pending further reconsideration.
words.chinese: 重新考慮；再次審查

words.engDef: to put right something that is wrong
words.example: The company needs to rectify the errors in the financial report before submitting it to the board.
words.chinese: 糾正；修正（錯誤、問題等）

words.engDef: to happen again
words.example: The system error recurred despite the recent software update.
words.chinese: 再次發生；重複出現
words.rootPrefix: re- (back) + curr (to run) -> to run back again

words.engDef: excessive bureaucracy or adherence to rules and formalities
words.example: We had to cut through a lot of red tape to secure the building permit.
words.chinese: 繁文縟節，官僚作風
words.rootPrefix: red + tape (from tying documents with red ribbons)

words.engDef: to do something a second time
words.example: The report contained several errors, so we need to redo it.
words.chinese: 重新做；再次執行（某項工作或任務）

words.engDef: made smaller in size, amount, or price
words.example: The company offered a reduced price for the bulk order.
words.chinese: 減少；降低（數量、價格、規模等）

words.engDef: to look at something again in order to check it
words.example: The accounting department will reexamine the expense reports to ensure accuracy.
words.chinese: 重新審查；再次檢查（通常是為了修正錯誤或尋找更多資訊）

words.engDef: to mention something, or to look at a source for information
words.example: Please refer to the attached document for more details about the project.
words.chinese: 指涉；提及；參考；查閱

words.engDef: a number used to identify a document or transaction
words.example: Please provide your reference number so we can track your order.
words.chinese: 參考編號；識別碼，用於追蹤或識別特定文件、交易或請求。

words.engDef: sent someone to another person for help, or mentioned something
words.example: The manager referred the issue to the legal department for review.
words.chinese: 推薦；委託處理；提及

words.engDef: mentioning something, or sending someone elsewhere for help
words.example: The report refers to several key changes in the company's strategy.
words.chinese: 指涉；提及；關於

words.engDef: to fill something again
words.example: The office manager needs to refill the printer paper before the meeting.
words.chinese: 重新裝填；補滿；再次供應

words.engDef: shows or is a sign of something
words.example: The company's annual report reflects its commitment to sustainable practices.
words.chinese: 反映；體現；呈現

words.engDef: food and drink served at an event
words.example: Light refreshments will be served during the break.
words.chinese: 點心，茶點；恢復精力，提神

words.engDef: to consider someone or something to be a certain thing
words.example: The company regards employee training as a top priority.

words.engDef: to record a name or fact on an official list

words.chinese: 徹底地；完全地；仔細地（表示某事被執行或檢查非常周到、詳細）

words.engDef: to move someone or something to another place

words.chinese: 翻轉；轉換；交接（文件、資料等）

words.chinese: 對...不感興趣；漠不關心

words.engDef: not known or not identified

words.chinese: 未知的；不熟悉的；尚未被發現的

words.engDef: not likely to happen or be true
words.example: It's unlikely that the project will be completed on time given the current delays.
words.chinese: 不太可能；可能性很小

words.chinese: 不必要的；多餘的

words.engDef: not achieving the intended result

words.engDef: in a way that is not normal or common

words.engDef: steady and never changing

words.engDef: the greatest amount or degree possible

words.chinese: 騰空；釋放；撤離（職位或空間）

words.engDef: remaining acceptable or usable for a stated period

words.chinese: 適用於；有效於；在...期間有效

words.engDef: to check that something is correct, or to make it official

words.chinese: 驗證；確認；使生效

words.engDef: of many different kinds

words.chinese: 多樣的；各異的；種類繁多的

words.chinese: 自動販售機，一種提供商品（如飲料、零食）供使用者購買的機器。

words.engDef: to check that something is true or accurate

words.chinese: 核實；確認；驗證

words.engDef: almost completely

words.engDef: to form a picture of something in your mind

words.chinese: 想像、視覺化，將抽象概念或數據轉化為圖像或模型以便理解。

words.engDef: a system that records spoken messages from callers

words.chinese: 語音信箱；留言服務

words.engDef: not legally valid; also an empty space

words.engDef: large amounts; also single books in a set

words.chinese: 熱身運動或活動，通常在正式活動或工作前進行，以提高注意力、準備身體或心理。

words.engDef: rooms with toilets and washbasins

words.chinese: 洗手間；盥洗室（通常指公共場所的洗手間）

words.engDef: to make someone very tired, or to use something until it breaks
words.example: After a long day of negotiations, the team was completely worn out.
words.chinese: 耗盡精力；使疲憊不堪（通常指經過長時間的努力或使用）

words.engDef: the day after Tuesday

words.chinese: 星期三

words.engDef: the evenings from Monday to Friday

words.chinese: 工作日夜晚，通常指星期一至星期五的夜晚。

words.engDef: a long time before something happens
words.example: Please submit your expense reports well in advance of the deadline.
words.chinese: 遠早於；提早很多

words.engDef: fully ready for what is going to happen
words.example: The team was well-prepared for the presentation, resulting in a successful outcome.
words.chinese: 準備充分的；預先備好的

words.engDef: on the subject of; in the matter of

words.chinese: 當談到...時；就...而言時

words.engDef: over a large area or among many people

words.chinese: 廣泛地；普遍地；在廣大範圍內

words.engDef: to turn the small wheel that keeps a watch going
words.example: Before the meeting, please wind your watch to ensure you arrive on time.
words.chinese: 為手錶上鍊；調整手錶時間

words.engDef: to remove marks or liquid by rubbing

words.chinese: 擦拭掉；清除（污漬、痕跡等）

words.engDef: concerning; in relation to

words.chinese: 關於；就...而言；鑒於

words.engDef: apart from; not including

words.chinese: 除...以外；不包括...

words.engDef: while the lights are still switched on

words.chinese: 燈光未關閉的狀態；在燈光亮著的情況下

words.engDef: as long as the request stays sensible

words.chinese: 在合理範圍內；在可接受的限度內

words.engDef: immediately

words.chinese: 立即；毫不延遲

words.engDef: with no warning given in advance

words.chinese: 未事先通知；突然地

words.engDef: without considering something

words.chinese: 不考慮、不顧及，不加區別地

words.engDef: the surroundings and conditions in which people work

words.chinese: 工作環境：指員工在辦公室或工作場所中實際工作的情境，包含物理空間、工作氛圍、同事關係等。

words.engDef: to do a task together in small teams
words.example: To maximize efficiency, we encourage employees to work in groups for brainstorming sessions.
words.chinese: 以小組方式工作；團隊合作

words.engDef: to spend time doing or improving something
words.example: I'm working on a new marketing campaign for the upcoming product launch.
words.chinese: 致力於；從事於；處理（某項工作或任務）

words.engDef: to work beyond your normal hours
words.example: Due to the approaching deadline, employees are required to work overtime this week.
words.chinese: 加班，額外工作（通常指超出正常工作時間）

words.engDef: a day on which people normally work

words.chinese: 工作日，通常指星期一至星期五的工作天。

words.engDef: the amount of work a person has to do
words.example: The manager needs to redistribute the workload to ensure everyone can meet the deadline.
words.chinese: 工作量；任務負擔

words.engDef: a sheet of paper with exercises or tasks on it

words.chinese: 工作表；練習題（通常用於課堂或培訓，包含練習題或活動，供學習者完成）

words.engDef: an area allocated for one's work, as in an office
words.example: Employees are encouraged to keep their workspace clean and clutter-free.

words.example: Every new employee is assigned a modern workstation with dual monitors.
words.chinese: 工作站，個人辦公空間

words.engDef: to finish something; to cover something in paper

words.chinese: 結束；收尾；包裝完畢

words.engDef: a small clock worn on the wrist

words.chinese: 腕錶；手錶

words.engDef: to record something on paper
words.example: Please write down the meeting minutes and distribute them to all attendees.
words.chinese: 記錄下來；寫下（重要資訊或指示）

words.engDef: to write a full report from notes
words.example: The marketing team needs to write up a report summarizing the results of the recent campaign.
words.chinese: 撰寫報告；整理說明

words.engDef: a set of blank sheets fastened together for writing on

words.chinese: 書寫墊；便條墊，通常用於辦公室或會議中快速記錄。

words.engDef: relating to the end of the financial or calendar year
words.example: The year-end financial report is due by December 15th.
words.chinese: 年度末；年末
